violations.description: Preventing contamination by consumers. — --Food on display for self service was not properly protected by food guards, display cases, or similarly effective means Hot dog roller not provided with adequate sneeze protection. Line of sight with products on rollers.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Cabinets rotting from water damage at customer self service soda dispensers.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Pooling liquid under soda dispensers at customer self service counter.
Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Large holes in wall under 3 tub sink system.
